summary: Valley County ground lookout on the Payette NF: a 1933 log cabin, then a 1956 metal cab that was moved to Sheepeater Mountain in 1975 or 1976. No source describes the original site today.

facts.design: 14-by-14-foot log cabin (1933), replaced in 1956 by a CL-100 metal cab on the ground
facts.status_note: The cab was moved to Sheepeater Mountain; no source we read describes what remains at the original site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Lookout Mountain pages date the cab's move to 1975; Sheepeater pages date the metal cab's installation there to 1976 and the register dates the current Sheepeater cab to 1976. The story gives both years.

sources.title: Lookout Mtn. (Payette N.F.) Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Move year conflicts: 1975 on the Lookout Mountain pages versus 1976 on the Sheepeater pages and in the register. Elevation is 8680 ft on firelookout.com and 8669 ft on Idaho Fire Lookouts; not used in facts. A Payette NF Facebook post seen only in search results gives 1957 for the steel replacement; not read in full, so not used. No staffing or fire sources were found for the original site. Original site access and remains not described by any source read.
